communication_preferences.style: Concise executive bullets upfront, backed by capacity metrics and risk heatmaps.
communication_preferences.preferred_channel: Written brief ahead of live discussion
communication_preferences.dislikes: Long slide walkthroughs without an explicit decision ask

communication_preferences.style: Technically precise with architecture diagrams, telemetry percentiles, and failure-mode tables.
communication_preferences.dislikes: Vague delivery estimates without named dependency owners

communication_preferences.style: Customer-impact framing with clear decision options, trade-offs, and target dates.
communication_preferences.preferred_channel: Timeboxed agenda with explicit owner sign-offs
communication_preferences.dislikes: Open-ended brainstorming when a go/no-go decision is overdue

communication_preferences.style: Commercial takeaways focused on renewal risk, SLA credits, and customer communication timelines.
communication_preferences.preferred_channel: Plain-language summary and direct action checklist
communication_preferences.dislikes: Unexplained network jargon without customer impact translation

communication_preferences.style: Control mappings, audit evidence links, and explicit risk-acceptance sign-offs.
communication_preferences.preferred_channel: Formal written briefing with traceable minutes
communication_preferences.dislikes: Informal verbal sign-offs on security exceptions

communication_preferences.style: CapEx vs. OpEx breakdowns, unit-cost tables, and budget variance thresholds.
communication_preferences.preferred_channel: Structured figures sent at least one business day prior
communication_preferences.dislikes: Unvetted budget numbers introduced live during sign-off calls
